title: Open Peeps — modular people must preserve the scene
summary: Treat interchangeable character parts as constrained scene components whose gaze, pose and contact must preserve the intended action.
use_when: A persona, welcome or storyboard needs a human scene with a readable shared action.
avoid_when: The available pose cannot represent the required anatomy, technical action or cultural detail faithfully.
